table.name: conversation_primary_docs
table.description: Stores the "dominant" document for a conversation to ensure UI persistence. One row per conversation (upserted).

columns.column: The conversation this primary doc belongs to. Unique constraint ensures 1:1 relationship.
The unique key of the document (e.g., "file::memory.core.md").
The absolute path or filename of the source file.
The knowledge domain of the document.
When this document was first selected as primary for this conversation.
When this document was last resurfaced or re-selected.

indexes.index: Ensures fast lookup by conversation and enforces 1:1 mapping.

component.name: PrimaryDocSelector
component.description: Selects the primary document from search results.

rules.rule: If RetrievalMode == NORMAL, prefer top result if Score > 0.01.
If Explicit Intent ("retrieve that file"), prefer Stored Doc unless New Score > 0.6.
